fallbacks.subagents: Sequential fresh-context review using the exact base..head package; report degraded independence.
fallbacks.browser_verification: Use Replit preview evidence and record automated browser assertions as Not Run.

supported_runtime_versions: Replit Agent workspaces that read repository instruction files
install: Commit REPLIT.md at the repository root of the Repl.
rollback: Restore the previous revision from version control.
limitations: Linux-only container. No independent subagents. Activation is instructed and must be measured in a clean session.
deprecation: None. Adapter is active and supported.
